item.title: Clean Sweep 0.6.3 Preview
item.description:
# Clean Sweep 0.6.3 Preview
- **Download updates directly.** Future update notices have a **Download** button that starts the complete ZIP download in your default browser, without sending you through the GitHub release page. - Mac notices retain release notes, **Later**, and **Skip This Version**. Automatic notices wait until Lightroom is idle and active. - Windows notices also use **Download** and link straight to the ZIP.
Install this version to get the new button. Your older installed version will still use its existing update notice to download 0.6.3.
Installation remains manual: finish or stop your batch, close the floating window, replace the complete `RemovalQueue.lrplugin` folder, and reload it in Plug-in Manager. Your photo edits, saved queue, brush preferences, and update connection are kept.
This remains a preview. Automated signed-feed and notice tests pass; native update interaction and the single-pass processing checks in Lightroom still need manual verification.
